name: 8 Lire XL
notes: The SOMA Lyra-8 after its manual (v2.1). The card is its 46 controls: TUNE per voice; source (FM / off / LFO), MOD, SHARP, FAST per pair; HOLD, PITCH per group; 34>56 78>12, TOTAL FB, VIBRATO; the Hyper LFO; the MOD DELAY; the DISTORTION. The rear jacks are inputs; the Lyra switches them by plugging, here a crossfader inside the assembly (0 = unplugged). Not here: outside audio into EXT IN (no audio input module), the plates' skin response (velocity and aftertouch stand in).
